entries.title: Genesis 46:1
segments: In undertaking a journey, or entering upon any new plan, we should feel our dependence upon God, seek his blessing, and commit ourselves to hsi guidance and care.

entries.title: Genesis 46:4
segments: Bring thee up again; that is, thy posterity.
In view of this fact, both Jacob and Joseph,

, commanded that their bodies should be buried in the land of Canaan. 
 
  Put his hand upon thine eyes; Joseph should be with his father, and close his eyes when he should die. 
 
With the blessing of God we need not fear to undertake any service, make any sacrifice, or endure any trial to which he may call us.

entries.title: Genesis 46:27
segments: Threescore and ten; seventy; namely, the sixty-six mentioned
, with Jacob, Joseph, and his two sons.  The Greek version of the Seventy here adds from
, five grandsons of Joseph, computation seems to have been followed by Stephen.

entries.title: Genesis 46:30
segments: Men may receive such blessings as to desire no more on earth, and be willing at any time to leave it, and enter into heaven.

entries.title: Genesis 46:34
segments: A wise regard for our friends will ordinarily lead us to wish them to continue in the employment in which they have been educated and with which they are acquainted, as promising greater happiness to themselves and greater usefulness to others.
